scenarios.title: IoTDB system overview
scenarios.summary: A ConfigNode coordinates partition metadata. A DataNode executes work against locally hosted regions and files.

components.label: Client

components.label: ConfigNode
components.description: Manages cluster metadata and partition assignments.

components.label: DataNode
components.description: Hosts query execution, replication and local storage.

components.label: Partition map
components.description: Maps work to region replicas.

timeline.label: Submit a measurement
timeline.detail: The client reaches a DataNode through the query or write execution path.

timeline.label: Resolve the data region
timeline.detail: Cluster partition metadata connects devices and time partitions with a region group.

timeline.label: Execute on the region
timeline.detail: The local region applies the mutation. IoTConsensus V1 can dispatch to its region peers.

timeline.label: Persist the file data
timeline.detail: A storage-engine flush materializes buffered data as TsFile chunks.

timeline.label: Read across files
timeline.detail: DataNode fragment execution coordinates query work. The storage layer supplies persisted and in-memory data.

scenarios.title: From memory to disk
scenarios.summary: A teaching example follows temperature=21.4 at t=100. Flush and close are separate operations.

components.label: DataRegion
components.description: Local storage and file lifecycle within a region.

components.label: WALNode
components.description: Logs mutations and tracks memtable lifecycle.

components.label: Working MemTable
components.description: Buffers inserts before flush.

structure.name: memTableId
structure.meaning: Associates the insert with the working memtable in the WAL

components.label: TsFileProcessor
components.description: Coordinates WAL, working and flushing memtables, and open TsFile writes.

components.label: TsFile
components.description: An open file can receive flushed chunks before finalization.

components.label: Compaction
components.description: Merges selected persisted files under storage-engine rules.

timeline.label: Route one insert
timeline.detail: The region routes the measurement to a working TsFileProcessor.

timeline.label: Log the write
timeline.detail: For this insert-row path, the processor resolves the WAL listener result before mutating the working memtable. Durability depends on configured WAL mode.

timeline.label: Mutate the working memtable
timeline.detail: The insert reaches the working memtable after the WAL step.

timeline.label: Encode and append chunks
timeline.detail: A flushing memtable is handed to MemTableFlushTask. The flush appends data without necessarily sealing the file.

timeline.label: Finalize the TsFile
timeline.detail: Closing the writer finalizes metadata and the file tail.

timeline.label: Compact eligible files
timeline.detail: A later compaction can rewrite eligible files. The scheduler and query use file state managed by the region; tier management is a separate concern.

timeline.label: Read the requested time range
timeline.detail: A reader uses persisted chunk/page metadata to locate and decode file data.

scenarios.title: IoTConsensus V1 replication
scenarios.summary: One local write and two asynchronous outbound peer channels in one region group.

components.label: Writer
components.description: Sends a local write.

components.label: DataNode A
components.description: Local state machine and source index.

components.label: Local indexed WAL
components.description: Fallback input for asynchronous dispatch.

components.label: LogDispatcher
components.description: Collects indexed requests, builds batches and manages each remote peer channel.

components.label: DataNode B
components.description: Applies requests from A through its RPC handler.

components.label: DataNode C
components.description: Has independent replication progress.

timeline.label: Apply locally
timeline.detail: The state machine runs under the local write lock. Only a successful result advances the local index and enters outbound dispatch.

timeline.label: Retain an indexed write
timeline.detail: The dispatcher can read WAL when needed, for example when its in-memory buffer does not cover a range.

timeline.label: Build per-peer batches
timeline.detail: Each outbound channel tracks pending data and its own synchronization indexes.

timeline.label: Apply on DataNode B
timeline.detail: The remote RPC handler decodes the batch and invokes the target group’s replication path.

timeline.label: One destination is unavailable
timeline.detail: This illustrative peer outage stalls C’s progress independently of B. Local success is not a quorum acknowledgment.

timeline.label: Retry the lagging channel
timeline.detail: The dispatcher keeps asynchronous retry and index management per peer.

timeline.label: Advance peer progress
timeline.detail: Successful synchronization advances that channel. WAL retention must account for peers that still need the writes.

scenarios.title: Inside a TsFile
scenarios.summary: Explode a Java TsFile from the file tail to a decoded page. Positions separate the logical regions for inspection.

components.label: TsFile
components.description: Magic and version frame the data and metadata sections.

components.label: ChunkGroup
components.description: Groups chunks under a device identity.

components.label: Chunk
components.description: Holds pages for a measurement or aligned stream.

components.label: Page
components.description: Encoded data and page headers. Compression is applied to the encoded page payload.

components.label: Metadata index
components.description: Index entries navigate to series metadata and chunk offsets.

components.label: Reader
components.description: Loads footer metadata and reads pages for selected chunks.

timeline.label: Open the file
timeline.detail: The writer starts a file with a format header.

timeline.label: Expand the device group
timeline.detail: A ChunkGroup marks data for a device; multiple chunks can follow the group header.

timeline.label: Inspect a chunk
timeline.detail: Chunk headers describe the measurement or aligned stream and its data representation.

timeline.label: Encode and compress the page
timeline.detail: The writer serializes encoded bytes and may compress the page body with the configured compressor.

timeline.label: Write the index and tail
timeline.detail: The writer serializes metadata and ends with the metadata size and closing magic.

timeline.label: Find the required chunks
timeline.detail: The reader loads file metadata and uses index and series metadata to seek to chunk offsets.

timeline.label: Read the page body
timeline.detail: The reader checks page sizes and materializes the body for decoding.

scenarios.title: Before · WAL retention
scenarios.summary: An already-published single-replica boundary can race new channel registration.

components.label: Source peer
components.description: Hosts the original region copy.

components.label: Incremental WAL
components.description: Holds indexes newer than the snapshot frontier.

components.label: Snapshot · 100
components.description: Teaching example fixed at index 100.

components.label: Replacement peer
components.description: Needs the snapshot and later entries.

timeline.label: Publish the single-replica boundary
timeline.detail: An earlier cleanup pass can see a MAX_VALUE retention boundary.

timeline.label: Register the replacement
timeline.detail: The replacement is registered at index 100 without immediately restoring WAL retention.

timeline.label: Capture snapshot at index 100
timeline.detail: Subsequent writes must still be replayable from the sender.

timeline.label: Delete WAL above the snapshot
timeline.detail: A stale cleanup cutoff can discard indexes required by this peer. The pre-fix dispatcher could skip gaps.

scenarios.title: After · WAL retention
scenarios.summary: Reconstruction preserves newly required WAL and prevents dispatch from skipping an index gap.

components.label: Source peer
components.description: Hosts the original region copy.

components.label: Incremental WAL
components.description: Holds indexes newer than the snapshot frontier.

components.label: Snapshot · 100
components.description: Teaching example fixed at index 100.

components.label: Replacement peer
components.description: Needs the snapshot and later entries.

timeline.label: Register under the write lock
timeline.detail: Capture index 100 and register the channel while local writes cannot advance it.

timeline.label: Publish the retention boundary
timeline.detail: Retention publication is serialized. Each WAL file eligibility check and deletion is coordinated with boundary changes.

timeline.label: Transfer the snapshot
timeline.detail: Snapshot transfer and replay run without holding the registration locks.

timeline.label: Replay contiguous WAL
timeline.detail: Catch-up waits for the coordinator’s fixed outbound frontier. An unexpected gap halts that dispatch channel.

contributions.title: [IoTConsensus] Preserve WAL needed by reconstructed peers
contributions.problem: Replica reconstruction could lose post-snapshot WAL.
contributions.design: Publish retention during channel registration and stop dispatch at unexpected gaps.

contributions.title: Fix multi-recovery metadata indexing and add regression coverage.
contributions.problem: Repeated recovery could duplicate logical device groups.
contributions.design: Compare device values while collecting recovered chunk metadata.

contributions.title: [rc/2.0.12] Fix deletion WAL logging and flush completion ordering
contributions.problem: Deletion logging depended on flush phase ordering.
contributions.design: Coordinate the WAL and flush lifecycle on the 2.0.12 release branch.
